Professional Pathways

Sports Academic Programs

Sports education is not merely about physical well-being but also about acquiring essential skills such as teamwork, discipline, and determination. It is crucial to understand the dynamics of sports in today's fast-paced world for both personal and professional development.

Minor Degree in Sports

Minor Degree in Sports under the Design Your Own Degree initiative allows students to pursue a Minor in Sports alongside any major discipline. The program offers a flexible, industry-oriented curriculum that blends classroom learning with hands-on experience in sports science, management, athletic training, leadership, tournament organization, and sports marketing. Students benefit from mentorship by professional coaches and sports administrators, exposure to industry networks, and cross-disciplinary integration with engineering, design, management, or arts—enhancing career opportunities in the growing sports industry.

VAC (Value Added Course)

VAC (Value Added Course) in Physical Education is designed to promote physical fitness, wellness, and lifelong healthy habits among students of all disciplines. The course focuses on developing fundamental physical skills, understanding fitness and health principles, teamwork, leadership, and stress management through structured physical activities and practical sessions. It enhances overall well-being, discipline, and personal development, while encouraging an active lifestyle that supports academic success and holistic growth.

SEC (Skill Enhancement Course)

SEC (Skill Enhancement Course) in Sports is a practice-oriented program aimed at developing essential sports skills, fitness techniques, and game-specific competencies. The course emphasizes hands-on training, teamwork, leadership, discipline, and performance improvement while building practical knowledge in sports rules, coaching basics, and event participation. Designed for students of all disciplines, it enhances physical ability, confidence, and employability by nurturing transferable skills such as communication, collaboration, and time management through sports.
